Notification NO.NPSC/EXAM-6/2022 dt.20.02.2026 (Physical Fitness Test for Dy.SP NPTO ) 
 Published on : 20-02-2026 02:03 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/EXAM-6/2022 Dated 
 Kohima, 20 th February,2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In
pursuance of the Nagaland Public Service Commission’s Advertisement No.
NPSC-1/CTSE-2025 dated 7 th April, 2025 and Notification No.NPSC/EXAM-6/2022
dated 23 rd January , 2026 candidates bearing the following Roll
No(s) have been short-listed to appear for physical tests for the post Dy SP
NPTO under Home Department Police Establishment Branch. 
 Roll No(s): 
 25T2953 
 25T3012 
 25T3068 
 Candidates are directed to report to
the 4 th NAP Battalion Headquarter, Thizama, Nagaland, Kohima along with their
call letter on 23 rd February,
2026 at 09:00 A.M for the Physical Test. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission, 
 Kohima.
